business_objectives: Give the user a single calibrated dial over how simply Claude explains things in chat (off = normal; 1 = university student through 5 = first grader).
Make dense technical/financial explanations comprehensible on demand — for the user's own quick grasp and for pasting to non-expert stakeholders — WITHOUT corrupting the underlying facts.
Reuse across all ACOS work (planning, review, diligence, teaching) as an orthogonal, always-available layer that composes with every other skill.
primary_users: The direct ACOS operator (e.g. a PE real-estate-lending associate) who toggles the dial mid-session to quickly grasp dense technical/financial output.
Non-expert stakeholders who receive the simplified chat output pasted or forwarded to them (secondary/indirect consumer, never a direct system user).
top_user_problems_ranked: AI chat output is frequently too dense / jargon-heavy for fast comprehension or for sharing with non-experts, and there is no per-session control over its reading level.

Naive 'simplify this' corrupts exactly the things a PE real-estate lending professional cannot lose: precise figures (principal, XIRR, dates, LTV/DSCR), caveats, legal terms of art, and executable code/commands.
A one-shot 'explain simply' doesn't persist — the user must re-ask every turn.
feature_config.strategy_context: acos-eden-protocol is a framework-level, cross-cutting ACOS capability (not tied to a single client deal) that sits orthogonal to every other skill: a session-persistent output-simplicity filter implemented purely with Claude Code primitives (skill + hooks + .acos/state/ files), never as a native output style (that slot is exclusive and already holds 'Explanatory', and output styles are deprecated per T1 research). It re-applies the active reading level every turn via a UserPromptSubmit hook injector (registered LAST after autopilot-context-injector.py and eternity-resume-prepend.sh) rather than relying on model memory, and re-arms on /clear via a SessionStart hook. Its central design tension — resolved by the pre-seeded swarm research (R1-R7) — is reconciling maximal comprehension gain with a zero-tolerance Fidelity Floor for PE-lending-grade precision (exact numbers, caveats, legal terms, code/commands must survive byte-for-byte or verbatim).
constraints: Claude Code primitives only: skill (SKILL.md) + hooks + .acos/state/ files. Python 3 stdlib + bash, matching existing ACOS hook conventions (fail-open `|| printf ...` fallback).

MUST NOT be a native output style — output styles are a single exclusive slot, the project already sets "outputStyle": "Explanatory", and that mechanism is deprecated; an eden output-style would silently evict Explanatory. [T1]
Subagent Write is policy-blocked in this environment ("return findings as text"); artifact authoring uses the main thread or Bash writes. [T3]
Scope = top-level human-facing chat only — never Task() sub-agent I/O, evidence bundles, QA JSON, code, tool output, or generated artifact files. [T2]
Must coexist with the existing UserPromptSubmit hook chain (autopilot-context-injector.py -> eternity-resume-prepend.sh) and not disturb autopilot/eternity/Oracle. [T1]
Must never silently default an ambiguous invocation to a level — must confirm, honoring the global Confirmation Gate (P0).
known_dependencies: acos-knowledge-builder — donor of the plain-language ruleset (adopt language rules, reject the chunked tutor loop). [T1]
autopilot-context-injector.py — the proven UserPromptSubmit state-file + additionalContext re-injection pattern eden copies. [T1]
.acos/state/ conventions (oracle-session-threshold, model-session.yaml), session-cleanup.sh (SessionEnd), Oracle path modifiers. [T1]
Reading-level science: Flesch-Kincaid, Flesch Reading Ease, Dale-Chall familiar-word list. [T1/T2]
known_risks: Fidelity loss (rounded numbers, dropped caveats, paraphrased legal/technical terms) — CRITICAL for finance/diligence work. Mitigated by the Fidelity Floor + exempt-content passthrough. [T2]
Mis-scoping to sub-agent / machine-readable output would break orchestration. [T2]
Context salience decay of the injected directive over 50+ turns — mitigated by per-turn re-injection (hook), not model memory. [T2]
Unverified: whether Claude Code concatenates additionalContext from multiple same-event UserPromptSubmit hooks — must verify before wiring eden's hook. [T3, must-verify]
Over-simplification producing false confidence (a hedged answer sounding certain at L5). [T2]
runtime_guardrails: Injector hook (eden-level-injector.py) registered LAST in the UserPromptSubmit chain, after autopilot-context-injector.py and eternity-resume-prepend.sh; fail-open (`|| printf ...`).
Re-arm hook (eden-rearm) fires on SessionStart with matcher 'clear' so the directive survives /clear.
State stored at .acos/state/eden-level as a plain digit (file absent = off); this file must be EXCLUDED from session-cleanup.sh's SessionEnd purge so the level can persist across sessions.
Every per-turn injected directive states the active level in plain text (discoverability guardrail) plus the scope boundary (top-level chat only).
Grammar parser never silently clamps or defaults invalid input — returns an error stating the valid range (off, 1-5, on, status).
'on' with no further qualifier maps to level 5 (assumption, documented in open_questions) but must still pass through the Confirmation Gate when the invocation is otherwise ambiguous.

Oracle (PreToolUse temperature scoring) treats eden's .acos/state/ writes as negligible risk (score ~2, well under the default threshold of 9) — must not require elevated approval for normal toggling.

Exempt-content passthrough is byte-for-byte for: code/inline-code, shell commands, file paths, API/function names, config keys/values, URLs, citations, exact quotes, math/financial formulas, all numbers-with-units, defined entities (e.g. 'Borrower'), warning/regulatory language.
Self-verification of reading level is a lightweight internal heuristic only — NOT a guaranteed numeric Flesch-Kincaid computation; this caveat must be stated wherever self-verification is described.

feature_goals: Provide a single per-session dial (off, 1-5) that governs the reading level of top-level assistant chat responses only.
Guarantee zero fidelity-floor violations — every exact number, caveat, and exempt span survives verbatim regardless of level.
Persist the active level across turns (via hook re-injection, not model memory) and across /clear (via SessionStart re-arm), while remaining fully discoverable every turn.
Compose orthogonally with every other ACOS skill/agent without leaking into sub-agent I/O, evidence bundles, QA JSON, code, tool output, or generated artifact files.
Never silently guess an ambiguous level — surface a Confirmation-Gate-style clarification instead.
user_problems: AI chat output is frequently too dense / jargon-heavy for fast comprehension or for sharing with non-experts, and there is no per-session control over its reading level.

Naive 'simplify this' corrupts exactly the things a PE real-estate lending professional cannot lose: precise figures (principal, XIRR, dates, LTV/DSCR), caveats, legal terms of art, and executable code/commands.
A one-shot 'explain simply' doesn't persist — the user must re-ask every turn.
success_metrics: Selected level's reading target is hit (Flesch-Kincaid grade within the level's band; jargon-definition gate satisfied for L2-5).
Zero fidelity-floor violations: every exact number, caveat, and exempt span (code, paths, citations, legal terms) survives verbatim.
Filter persists across turns and across /clear; toggling off returns to normal with zero overhead.
Level is always discoverable (per-turn directive states the active level; status subcommand available).

architecture_constraints: Implementation limited to: one SKILL.md, hook scripts (Python 3 stdlib + bash), and .acos/state/ files — no native output style, no external services, no non-stdlib deps.
eden-level-injector.py (UserPromptSubmit) registered LAST, after autopilot-context-injector.py and eternity-resume-prepend.sh; fail-open fallback.
eden-rearm (SessionStart, matcher='clear') re-injects the directive after /clear without model memory.
Subagent Write is policy-blocked; all writes via main thread or Bash.
Scope enforcement is structural: apply ONLY to top-level human-facing chat, exclude Task() sub-agent I/O, evidence, QA JSON, code/diffs, tool output, generated files.
Oracle: eden's .acos/state/eden-level operations score ~2 (< threshold 9), no elevated approval for toggling.
technical_requirements: State file .acos/state/eden-level storing a single digit (1-5); absence == 'off'.
First-token grammar: bare->status; on->level 5; off->delete file; 1..5 and 'level N'->same path; status->alias. Invalid->explicit error, never silent clamp/default.
Ambiguous invocations route through Confirmation-Gate clarification (P0).
Two-axis level spec: FK grade + FRE (surface) AND vocabulary/jargon-definition gate (semantic).
Fidelity Floor (8 invariants) encoded as a checklist referenced by the injected directive every turn.
Exempt-content classifier: stdlib regex/pattern detection (code fences, inline code, path-like strings, URL regex, number-with-unit regex, capitalized defined-entity terms, citation markers).
Per-message override: raw:/L1: prefix parsed at message time, single-response only, never mutates the state file.
Precision appendix: default-on collapsible 'Exact figures & terms' block, sourced from the original (never re-derived from simplified text).
Self-verification: lightweight internal heuristic (NOT guaranteed numeric FK); caveat stated in tech PRD.
session-cleanup.sh (SessionEnd) must exclude .acos/state/eden-level from purge — a required modification to a shared script; flag as cross-cutting dependency.
Coexistence test: verify (or flag as spike) whether Claude Code concatenates additionalContext across multiple same-event UserPromptSubmit hooks before finalizing the injector contract.
data_model_entities: EdenLevel state — persisted value in .acos/state/eden-level (digit 1-5 or absent=off); single source of truth.
Level-spec table — level -> {reader profile, FK grade band, FRE band, max sentence length, vocabulary rule} for 1-5 plus 'off'.
Exempt-content classifier — ruleset/regex identifying exempt spans for verbatim passthrough.
Injector hook (eden-level-injector.py) — UserPromptSubmit hook; reads EdenLevel, emits per-turn directive; last in chain.
Re-arm hook (eden-rearm) — SessionStart hook (matcher='clear') re-establishing the directive after /clear.
Fidelity-floor ruleset — 8 hard invariants encoded as a checklist.
Per-message override — ephemeral parser for raw:/L1: prefixes; no persistent-state mutation.
Precision appendix — default-on collapsible 'Exact figures & terms' block; generation rule + trigger conditions.
Command grammar / parser — first-token router with explicit invalid-input error handling.
Confirmation-gate routing — routes ambiguous invocations to explicit clarification, not a guessed default.
Session-cleanup exclusion rule — modification preserving .acos/state/eden-level across sessions.
Self-verification heuristic — lightweight internal check with explicit non-guarantee caveat.

Then the two-axis reading-level engine wired to response shaping as Demo 3. Later slices (per-message override, self-verification, cleanup exclusion, agent docs) harden.
